title: Klaus
tagline: One letter, one toy. One plate, one pudding.
about: A spoiled postman sent to a frozen island town teams up with a reclusive toymaker to bring some joy.
cue: Serve the dessert when Jesper delivers the first toy to a child.

barley flatbreads cooked in a hot dry pan, spread with butter and topped with smoked salmon, sour cream, dill and lingonberry jam.Mix 120g rye flour, 80g barley or plain flour, half a tsp baking powder, a pinch of salt, 20g melted butter and about 150ml warm milk into a soft dough.Divide into 8 and roll very thin.Cook in a hot dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until speckled.Butter while warm and top with 200g smoked salmon, sour cream, a little lingonberry jam and dill.Pickled herring on rye crispbreadOnly herring and burbot today, says Alva.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot platesKlaus's juniper beef stew with mashBeef chuck braised with juniper, blackcurrant jam and carrots, over mashed potatoesHow to make it1.2kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions3 carrots1 tbsp plain flour6 juniper berries, crushed3 sprigs of thyme1 tbsp blackcurrant jam750ml beef stock1kg potatoes60g butter100ml full cream milkBrown the beef in batches.Slice the onions and chop the carrots, then cook with the beef.Stir in the flour, juniper, thyme, jam and stock.Cover and simmer until the beef falls apart.Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.Serve the stew over the mash.Spoilt postmaster's duck with cherry sauceDuck for the Postmaster General's spoilt sonHow to make itNot on tonight's cookDuck breasts scored and rendered skin side down until crisp, finished in the oven, sliced over a creamy potato gratin with a glossy cherry and balsamic sauce.Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180°C for 1 hour.Score the skin of 4 duck breasts and start skin side down in a cold pan, then cook over medium heat for 8 minutes to render.Flip and roast at 200°C for 6 minutes.Rest.Pour off most of the fat, add 200g pitted cherries, 2 tbsp balsamic, 1 tbsp honey and 150ml stock and reduce until glossy.SweetsDear Mr. Klaus gingerbread envelopesGingerbread cookies cut as envelopes with white icing and a
